profile.campus: True North Data campus, Loudoun County, VA (Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, PIN 194103673000, approved Jan 2018)
profile.reading: This building sits at 42310 Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, Virginia, part of a data center campus that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, filed under that project name, rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses, and was approved January 18, 2018. The underlying parcel, county PIN 194103673000, covering roughly 97 acres, is recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a legal structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus parcel into separately titled buildings, consistent with the six separate addresses and building records that make up this cluster. A 2019 grading permit for a project called True North 2 described three data center buildings with utilities, and a 2023 stormwater permit for True North Data Phase 2A covered a further 16.5 acres of disturbed area, indicating a phased expansion. Four tenant fit-up zoning permits were issued across April and May 2025, suggesting the campus was still being built out in phases as recently as that year. No document reviewed this session, however, gives a total megawatt capacity, final building count, or total square footage for the completed campus, and the identity of the corporate entity that actually filed the original 2017 rezoning application is not exposed in the county public zoning-case layer, so True North Data Solutions, the name this record carries as operator, could not be independently confirmed as a registered company through the Virginia State Corporation Commission this session. Loudoun County is widely described as the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and this campus location within it is consistent with the broader pattern of large-scale multi-building developments concentrated in the eastern part of the county.

profile.research_note: True North Data Solutions' own site publishes only company-wide totals ("10+ project sites," "673 MW capacity & growing" across 3 countries) with no facility-specific pages or addresses -- corporate office listed is in Calgary, AB. This Leesburg/Loudoun County VA campus (off Thunderball Drive) is reported in local press as a build-to-suit project (Compass Datacenters broke ground for True North); no public per-building spec sheet exists. One row on file is separately named "TikTok Data Center," consistent with reporting that this campus is a single-tenant build-to-suit, which explains the absence of public marketing specs.

reading.body:
This facility sits on a 97-acre parcel in Leesburg rezoned in 2018 specifically for data center use as part of a multi-building hyperscale campus. Loudoun County permitting records from 2019 and 2023 document at least three data center buildings under construction, with a 2025 grading permit suggesting phased build-out continued into that year. The operator has published no facility-specific capacity figure, but lists 673 MW across ten-plus project sites globally, making the per-building allocation unknowable from public sources.

The campus location sits in eastern Loudoun County, the world's largest data center market by capacity. Virginia state records publish 1,603.4 MW of total data center capacity across 25 facilities with disclosed figures; this parcel ranks 26th by published MW in Virginia, meaning either it lacks a published figure or falls below the threshold of disclosed sites. Local reporting identifies the campus as a single-tenant build-to-suit project, which explains the absence of public specification sheets typical of carrier-neutral facilities and suggests the facility was built for a named corporate end-user rather than marketed to the open market.

The corporate entity listed as operator, True North Data Solutions, is registered in Alberta and publishes only company-wide aggregate figures without facility-specific pages or addresses. The Leesburg location, described in press as built by Compass Datacenters, remains under construction as of 2025 according to permitting records. Without published megawatts, completed building count, or square footage for this campus, its scale and status cannot be directly measured against competing facilities in the state.
